_about: REAL measured rate (curated, not live). Dust obscuration of solar cells on the Mars surface.

source.product: Mars Pathfinder Materials Adherence Experiment (MAE): Landis & Jenkins, J. Geophys. Res. 105 (E1), 2000, doi:10.1029/1999JE001029

measured.note: About 0.28 % of solar-cell output lost per sol to settling dust during the first weeks on the surface; the lander arrays lost ~0.29 %/sol.

cleaning.electrodynamicDustShield: NASA Kennedy Space Center technology: electric fields lift dust off panels without moving parts (https://technology.nasa.gov/patent/KSC-TOPS-99).
cleaning.dustDevils: Dust devils cleaned the panels of the Spirit and Opportunity rovers several times (NASA/JPL).
